source_note: 现存御影堂于宽永十三年（1636）再建。 图版绘西本愿寺御影堂，不与东本愿寺御影堂或相邻阿弥陀堂混同。
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a Fanggu heritage line plate. Image 1 is the actual monument PHOTO and controls geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project black fine-contour STYLE sample; never transfer its Buddha subject. Draw the named Japanese building accurately as a complete, isolated elevation at nearly frontal view. Fine sparse black ink contours with a few structural lines; no broad dark fills, hatching, pencil grain or opaque silhouettes. Pure flat opaque WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, including every blank region inside and outside the subject. Center with generous margins. No shadow, gradient, texture, glow, checkerboard, color, text, labels, signage, people, foliage, surrounding buildings, watermark or frame. Subject: Nishi Hongan-ji Goeido Founder Hall, the ACTUAL 1636 large hall in the photo, not Higashi Hongan-ji nor the smaller Amida Hall. Preserve enormous single main roof, broad front veranda with many wooden posts and central stair; remove trees, lantern, visitors and paving.
